ai.proposal.title: Agent proposal
ai.proposal.apply.desc: Applies the whole proposal as one step; Ctrl+Z undoes it
ai.proposal.applied: The proposal was applied. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
ai.proposal.applied_resync: The proposal was applied, but the view did not update yet. It refreshes on its own; Ctrl+Z undoes the step.
ai.proposal.stale: The model changed after this proposal was previewed. Ask the agent to propose it again.
ai.proposal.toast.stale: The model changed after the preview, so nothing was applied. Preview again: ask the agent to propose it anew.
